# DEcoDLE

> A daily puzzle / rhythm hybrid that gates every guess behind a rhythm round. Players clear an Acoustic Cypher — a beat-matching round on an eight-symbol keyboard — to earn each guess attempt. Released April 24, 2026 on iOS and Android by Ad Astra Vanguard Studios LLC. Free with optional $2.99 PRO upgrade.

DEcoDLE is the first release from Ad Astra Vanguard Studios. The patent-pending Acoustic Cypher mechanic (USPTO provisional filings #64/037,214 base mechanic, #64/061,463 Classic+Evo coexistence model, both 2026) combines a Wordle-style five-symbol deduction puzzle with a rhythm gate. Eight-symbol alphabet, five-symbol hidden sequence drawn from those eight, up to six Puzzleboard rows per run. Cypher attempts themselves are unlimited; only the bonus Power-Up rewards depend on a clean run. Three modes (Daily, Endless, Challenge) and three difficulty tiers (Casual, Hard, Expert). The top in-game grade — FLAWLESS.EXE — is reachable on any difficulty through a perfect-timing or one-shot solve. A v1.1.0 update will add Acoustic Cypher Evolved (Evo) — a radial Cypher Dial visual alternate to the static center monitor — as a player-selectable mode.

- [DEcoDLE: The Journal Logs (Kindle)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX31SKMM/): Epistolary novel set in the DEcoDLE universe — a correspondence between two in-game AI characters, :/AI+> and :/System>. Releases June 12, 2026.
- [@DEcoDLE_app on X](https://x.com/DEcoDLE_app): Six-week serialized drip-cast of the novella, Monday–Thursday, five threads per day, May 4 – June 11, 2026.
